sensitive_artifact_categories.risk: May contain reusable DB/app credentials; never bulk-copy or print. These measured empty.pgpass files are classified by size only.
sensitive_artifact_categories.public_action: Exclude raw credential inputs; document empty-file size/hash only if separately approved and truly necessary.

sensitive_artifact_categories.risk: May embed response headers, bodies, supplied IDs, auth or connection configuration. JSON extension does not make it content-free.
sensitive_artifact_categories.public_action: Use explicit safe field projection and original artifact hashes; retain originals privately. Synthetic canary alone is not a general secret scan.

sensitive_artifact_categories.risk: Can hold exception messages, embedded source/assertion values, connection URLs, auth/token or request/user/content canaries; baseline negatives deliberately retain leaking behavior.
sensitive_artifact_categories.public_action: Review/redact a derivative without mutating the original; keep measured exit counts distinct from leak counts.

sensitive_artifact_categories.risk: Contains target identity, pseudonymous actor/request IDs, timestamps, PIDs and full-row digests; some environments may include connection inputs. Pseudonymous data is not anonymous.
sensitive_artifact_categories.public_action: Safe counts/booleans/source hashes in public summary; original identity receipts remain restricted with hash provenance.

sensitive_artifact_categories.risk: Uploaded content or rendered student/teacher data may be present. This scope contains generated storage fixtures; no claim that arbitrary future files are synthetic.
sensitive_artifact_categories.public_action: Exclude storage/cache/raw UI artifacts unless individually necessary and reviewed.

sensitive_artifact_categories.risk: Caches and copied execution trees add bulk and may duplicate private paths or fixture material.
sensitive_artifact_categories.public_action: Exclude generated caches; archive only exact required source/harness subset under source hashes.

global_limits: All evidence is local/synthetic within stated scopes; no legal compliance, anonymity, cloud readiness, genuine user auth or real LLM quality certification.
The whole raw result JSON is not automatically public-safe; process result embeds HTTP bodies/headers and raw identity metadata. This inventory uses explicit projection.
A source hash proves byte identity, not target ownership or source trust. Target provenance, process wait, phase accounting and independent negative controls must be kept together.
Row counts alone are insufficient: actual original full-row hash snapshots are part of the private proof.
No final current-source complete-acceptance claim until missing E2E02 and final static/hosted receipts are independently observed.
